professionalSummary.text: Three‑year senior analyst in a bank’s transaction screening team, responsible for weekly alert outcome analysis, rule and list change proposals, and forecasting alert volumes.
professionalSummary.witness: Financial crime data analyst in a bank's transaction screening team for three years, analysing the screening alert outcomes each week and proposing rule and list changes with their expected alert volumes.

professionalSummary.text: Prepared monthly screening effectiveness packs to the bank’s standard and filed them in the governance repository.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the monthly screening effectiveness pack under the pack standard, with the packs filed in the screening governance repository.

professionalSummary.text: Presented 27 proposals to the screening governance forum, defended them against compliance challenges, and secured approvals for 22 proposals.
professionalSummary.witness: Presented twenty-seven proposals to the screening governance forum; the forum minutes record the compliance members' challenges on each and the forum's decision, with twenty-two proposals approved as presented and five amended.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated rule changes with screening operations via change notes, clearly delineating responsibilities and maintaining forum approval authority.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the approved rule changes with the screening operations team through the change note, recording which checks were mine and which were operations'; the approvals were the forum's.

professionalSummary.text: Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each change note, ensuring clear documentation of change boundaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the limitation section and the hand-over conditions of each change note.
